item.text: The shell is blocked by a local sandbox configuration error, so I’m using the supplied evidence. The revision will move the opening blockers away from the artillery’s western pass and give each roadblock a clearance assignment.

The revised structure uses the two outer opening blockers to attack the eastern roadblocks, separate attackers for the western roadblocks, and casters covering successive artillery passes. The two medics will cross-cover the central formation. The outer handoffs depend on confirmed kills and roadblock destruction; those deadlines remain unverified.
